name: Vbot Humanoid Robot
summary: Vbot Humanoid Robot is the publicly presented humanoid prototype program from Vita Dynamics. The manufacturer describes perception, language interaction, task planning and mobile manipulation for household assistance. The cover is its official bipedal concept rendering, with two arms, hands and articulated legs. No formal alphanumeric model identifier or verified commercial delivery is established; planned capabilities should not be read as independently tested performance.
